title: Warm Light Portuguese Dried Fruit Toast
description: A quick and delicious Portuguese dish featuring dried fruit and toast, perfect for a diabetic-friendly snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped dried apricots and cranberries.
In another bowl, whisk together the honey and almond butter until smooth.
Arrange the bread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spread a layer of the honey-almond butter mixture on each bread slice.
Top each bread slice with a spoonful of the dried fruit mixture.
Sprinkle a pinch of cinnamon and lemon zest over the dried fruit.
Bake the toast in the preheated oven for 5 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Remove the toast from the oven and let it cool for a minute or two.
Serve the warm toast immediately, garnished with a sprinkle of salt if desired.
